# Vendored files

These are byte-identical copies from
[PR #4270](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4270) at head
`a929a3fa36301bdfcffe82afd37434dd9e3c4887`.

| Vendored file | Source path in #4270 | Git blob |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `OUTER-JOIN.md` | `research/complex-pooled-full-admission/OUTER-JOIN.md` | `50cf3eefd5a4198f011bf378c5d6ddd2319feb0a` |
| `pr4181-RESULT.json` | `research/complex-pooled-full-admission/frozen/pr4181/RESULT.json` | `5a0ba7aeeb39f849e09ab15cc65afb79028a20e2` |

They are copied, not pinned, because that PR head is not reachable from canonical main.
`verify.py` checks their SHA256 values before using them.

`OUTER-JOIN.md` was prepared for Ross Richardson with OpenAI Codex assistance. The pooled
fill result is Rohan Arun's (PR #4181). Both are Apache-2.0, as their packages state.
